name: Jesus Blood
overview: Scripture reveals that the blood of Jesus is central to the redemption and forgiveness of sins, fulfilling the Old Testament principle that life is in the blood and it makes atonement for the soul (Leviticus 17:11). Jesus’ blood inaugurates the new covenant, shed for many to bring remission of sins (Matthew 26:28), and believers are called to partake spiritually in His sacrifice for life (John 6:50, 53). The church is described as purchased by God through Jesus’ own blood (Acts 20:28), emphasizing the preciousness and efficacy of His sacrifice in securing salvation and grace (Ephesians 1:7).
